correctness.rationale: The proof starts from the explicit third-edge definition, proves the induced-star characterization, classifies all induced stars in rook graphs and requires disjoint row and column footprints across components. Exponential labelled enumeration yields all coefficients with correct factorial normalizations. Row and column resource inequalities prove the upper bound, explicit L-corner/horizontal constructions attain it, and parity forces the odd-square exception. Cases m=n=1 and even/odd optimizer counts are covered. The standalone direct graph-conflict verifier independently matches every coefficient for 21 boards and 852,484 legal sets, with 210 additional formula extrema checks. These finite computations support rather than replace the quantified proof.

value.rationale: Edge open packing is a motivated graph-edge interference invariant, tied to injective edge-color classes. A complete all-set size distribution on the natural two-parameter rook/line-graph family refines a scalar optimization problem; the sharp odd-square parity obstruction and closed maximum-set counts reveal non-obvious structural behavior. The classification is an infinite-family theorem rather than an arbitrary small-instance computation or mere reassignment of a known invariant.
